title: System Config
description: Service overview & resilience (HTTP retry/circuit-breaker + fallback); default backend/model set on dashboard
serviceOverviewDesc: Review listen address, response behavior, and common entry points.
listenInfoTip: Host and port come from install/env vars; saving here won't hot-restart the listener. To change the port, update startup config (e.g. LLM_PROXY_SERVER_PORT) and restart.
responseTraceDesc: When enabled, prepends a single-line flow trace before the reply
defaultBackendModelPipelineDesc: Set on the dashboard panel, shown in the bottom status bar
systemProxyEntryDesc: PAC / MITM main entry at 'Access → System Proxy'
accountAndPasswordDesc: Change password and API key in Profile
proxyResilienceDesc: Configure HTTP retry and circuit-breaker for upstream failures. For model/backend switching, use the 'Fallback Policy' tab.
retryableStatusCodesTip: Retry when upstream returns these status codes (hot-reload)
fallbackPolicyTip: Fallback policy sub-page has independent save
systemUpdateDesc: Check public GitHub Releases online, or upload a package for hot update
systemUpdateOnlineDesc: Pull Team update packages from GitHub Release (atoml-ai/centag)
systemUpdateCheckHint: Click "Check for Updates" to query the latest Team package
systemUpdateApplyConfirm: Upgrade to {version}? The service will restart briefly.
systemUpdateApplySuccess: Online update applied; service is restarting
systemUpdateDragTip: Drag file here, or click to select
systemUpdateHistoryDesc: Historical update records and rollback operations
systemUpdateOnlyOne: Can only upload one file, please remove the selected file first
systemUpdateMissingFile: Missing history file name, cannot operate
systemUpdateRollbackConfirm: Are you sure to rollback to version "{version}"?
systemUpdateDeleteConfirm: Are you sure to delete this update record?
deploymentDesc: Database selection and data-retention policy on uninstall (for fnOS / install-package deployments)
deploymentRestartTip: Database switch takes effect on the next service restart (the startup script reads this config and injects environment variables).
deploymentPgPasswordMasked: Saved; enter a new value to change
deploymentCleanDataDesc: Data is kept by default so config and keys survive a reinstall. When enabled, the data directory is wiped together with the app on uninstall.
configExportDesc: Export current backend configs and pipeline templates for quick restore or migration to a fresh environment
configExportDetail: The exported ZIP includes: backend configs (initial-backends.yaml), pipeline templates, environment variable template (.env), and a README. Extract on the new environment, fill in API Keys, and you're ready to go.
